input.free_text_description: This system is an authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for saml user details. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to interact with landing functionality, so that I can accomplish my landing-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with sso functionality, so that I can accomplish my sso-related tasks.
As a User, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Admin, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
